children: AstraZeneca PLC (AZN) reported third-quarter revenue of $16.21 billion, up 7%, and core earnings per share growth of 17%. The company confirmed its 2026 guidance.
AstraZeneca reported that Imfinzi and Padcev reduced death risk in a bladder cancer trial, with more patients surviving two years and showing no detectable cancer than with surgery alone.
AstraZeneca (AZN) ended its phase III eVOLVE-Lung02 trial of volrustomig in lung cancer on Aug. 17. Its SERENA-4 breast cancer trial of camizestrant missed its primary endpoint on Sept. 11.
AstraZeneca said overall-survival data from four Phase III trials will be presented at ESMO. Its CLARITY-Gastric01 trial showed a significant survival benefit in gastric cancer.
After AstraZeneca’s Q3 2026 report, nine of 10 analyst firms raised price targets by an average 4.4%; Jefferies held steady. Targets ranged from SEK 1,579 to SEK 2,697, with a SEK 2,171 median.
